200.description: Generation enqueued; returns the task id to poll.

data.description: Payload — shape depends on the endpoint

403.description: Plan entitlement required. `code: NO_TAX_YEAR_PLAN` (B2C/retail) — no active plan for the requested tax year AND that year holds more transactions than the free-tier allowance; the body carries `data: { current, limit }`. A year at or below the allowance is generated for free, with no plan. `code: ENTERPRISE_PLAN_REQUIRED` / `REPORTS_NOT_AVAILABLE` for the other workspace types.

404.description: Workspace not found, or the report is not available for the country.

405.description: Transaction limit exceeded — upgrade required to generate reports. `code: PLAN_TRANSACTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: the plan’s `features.totalTransactions` measured against the transactions in that tax year, with `data: { current, limit }`.

409.description: Accounting has not been calculated for the requested year yet.

422.description: No transactions exist for the requested year — nothing to report.
